2607.15919.title: On the Failure of Boundary-Seeking Distillation in Bottlenecked Generative Architectures
2607.15919.paper_summary: Data-free knowledge distillation transfers the knowledge encoded in a teacher model to a student model without access to the original training data. Prior work such as Contrastive Abductive Knowledge Extraction (CAKE) achieves this for classifiers by synthesizing samples near the teacher's decision boundary. In this work, we investigate whether this boundary-seeking principle extends to autoencoder distillation through experiments on the MNIST dataset . To enable a direct comparison, we reformulate continuous reconstruction as a dense, per-feature classification task, allowing the decoder to output categorical logits. We show that boundary-seeking objectives are fundamentally ill-posed in bottlenecked generative architectures. CAKE operates on a single, instance-level objective, but a decoder acts as an array of tightly coupled, feature-level classifiers constrained by a shared low-dimensional bottleneck. Independently sampling contrastive targets for these coupled outputs violates the geometry of the learned latent manifold and produces severe gradient conflicts instead of informative boundary samples. Manifold-aware synthesis bypasses these conflicts entirely and establishes an effective baseline for data-free generative distillation.
2607.15919.paper_summary_zh: 資料無關的知識蒸餾將教師模型中編碼的知識轉移至學生模型，而不需訪問原始訓練數據。先前的工作，例如對比推理知識提取（CAKE），通過合成接近教師決策邊界的樣本來實現這一點。本文中，我們通過對MNIST數據集的實驗調查這一邊界尋求原則是否擴展到自編碼器蒸餾。為了進行直接比較，我們將連續重建重新表述為一個密集的、每特徵的分類任務，允許解碼器輸出類別邏輯。 我們顯示邊界尋求目標在瓶頸生成架構中根本上是病態的。CAKE在單一的實例級目標上運作，但解碼器作為一組緊密耦合的特徵級分類器，受限於共享的低維瓶頸。獨立地為這些耦合輸出採樣對比目標違反了學習的潛在流形的幾何結構，並產生嚴重的梯度衝突，而不是信息豐富的邊界樣本。流形感知合成完全繞過這些衝突，並為無數據生成蒸餾建立了一個有效的基準。
2607.15919.author: Mohamed Amine Kina et.al.
